PagePaymentOptionInput.description:
Configures a single payment option shown at checkout. Multiple options can be combined (e.g. pay in full + pay via invoice) or a single option can be offered alone.

**Option types:**
- `full` — customer pays the entire amount immediately.
- `manual` — no payment is collected at checkout. A confirmation with an invoice is sent and the order is marked unpaid. Set `manualType` to `invoice` or `cash_on_delivery`.
- `partial` — customer pays `partialAmount` now; the remaining balance is due later and the order is marked as partially paid.

Digital files and event tickets are always issued immediately after checkout regardless of which option the customer selects. [Learn more](https://checkoutpage.com/docs/articles/manual-payments-pay-in-full-by-invoice-pay-deposit-or-cash-on-delivery)

ProductDetailsInput.description:
Product configuration for checkout pages.

Use this object to define pricing mode, subscription/payment plan behavior, inventory, variants, and conditional variant visibility.

Common setup patterns:
- Standard one-time checkout: set `price.amount`, `price.currency`, and keep `price.pricingType` as `single`.
- Variant-driven pricing: set `price.pricingType` to `multiple`, then define `variants` and per-option `additionalChargeAmount`.
- Subscriptions (recurring): configure `price.recurring`.
- Payment plans (fixed installments): configure `price.paymentPlan` with `planIterations`.

Important rules:
- You cannot set both `price.recurring` and `price.paymentPlan`.
- `price.payWhatYouWant` cannot be used with subscriptions or payment plans.
- For conditional variant logic (`showHideLogic`) or `preselect`, set a `key` on variants/options to enable cross-references. Keys are not persisted.

| Value | Description | Required fields |
|-------|-------------|-----------------|
| `always_available` | Always on sale (default). | — |
| `date_time_based` | On sale between `saleStartOn` and `saleEndOn`. Omit either date to leave that end open. | `saleStartOn` and/or `saleEndOn` |

| `after_ticket_sold_out` | Becomes available once the trigger ticket sells out. | `triggerTicketType` or `triggerTicketGroup` |
| `after_ticket_ends_or_sold_out` | Becomes available once the trigger ticket's sale ends **or** it sells out, whichever comes first. | `triggerTicketType` or `triggerTicketGroup` |
| `until_event_starts` | On sale until the event's `startDate` is reached. | — |

post.description:
Creates a checkout page together with its product and default fields in a single request.

Use this endpoint whenever you need to accept payments. It supports four payment flows, controlled by the `productData.price` object:

- **One-time payment** — set `price.amount` and `price.currency`. Do not set `price.recurring`, `price.paymentPlan`, or `price.payWhatYouWant`.
- **Pay What You Want (PWYW)** — set `price.payWhatYouWant: true`. `price.amount` becomes the minimum; leave it at `0` to allow free purchases. PWYW cannot be combined with subscriptions or payment plans.
- **Subscription (recurring)** — set `price.recurring` with `interval` (`day`, `week`, `month`, or `year`) and `intervalCount`. Optionally add `trialPeriodDays` or a `billingCycleAnchorConfig`.
- **Payment plan (installments)** — set `price.paymentPlan` with `interval`, `intervalCount`, and `planIterations` (the fixed number of payments after which the plan completes).

`price.recurring` and `price.paymentPlan` are mutually exclusive — set only one.

Default name and email fields are always created automatically. Pass `fields` to add extra checkout fields.
